tldr: Sun through the 6th house brings focus to work routines, health, service, labor, and maintenance.
body: Sun transiting the 6th house illuminates work routines, health, service, labor, and maintenance. For about a month, attention, vitality, and conscious focus move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a visibility transit: it shows where your life force wants to be recognized, strengthened, and chosen consciously.
business: Sun supports daily systems and practical support: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Ego inflation, overexposure, or overwork or neglecting the body.
advice: Use the spotlight in the 6th house deliberately. Work with work routines, health, service, labor, and maintenance without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
